crossRefs.note: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah…
When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him…
He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
“Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was…
By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted…

translations.web: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
translations.bsb: But the woman did conceive, and at that time the next year she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.
translations.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
translations.asv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season, when the time came round, as Elisha had said unto her.
